cases.scenario: Preview look check with no runtime: lists numeric checks and views, routes to blendops-connect-blender
cases.inputPrompt: Apply blendops-look-check to a sneaker product-hero preview. No Blender runtime is connected.
expectedBehavior: Produces numeric_check_report, multi_view_capture_record, visual_issue_list for role preview-look-check-loop
Lists numeric checks before any visual review and preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blendops-connect-blender (Runtime is not ready for checks)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs the check order in skills/blendops-look-check/SKILL.md
Matches contract fallback predicate to blendops-connect-blender in skills/blendops-look-check/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Run readiness checks in blendops-connect-blender before checking the preview.
simulatedOutput.summary: Listed the numeric checks (size, scale, ground, in frame, material, camera, lights), three views to capture and the three-round fix loop, and routed to blendops-connect-blender because no runtime is ready.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

expectedBehavior: Evaluates the progression handoff predicate in skills/blendops-look-check/contract.json
Routes to blendops-final-check without claiming Verified
evidenceRequirements: Contract progression handoff predicate match to blendops-final-check

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off to blendops-final-check to check the preview against the done criteria.
simulatedOutput.summary: Matched progression predicate quality.verdict=pass and routed to blendops-final-check.

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off to blendops-build to fix the top issue with one step, then check again.

expectedBehavior: Enforces the blendops-look-check exclusion boundary for final verification
Delegates to blendops-final-check without marking anything Verified
